user_prompt: For an industrial power buyer, compare fixed-window renewable delivery offers with backup supply. Separate energy coverage from fully served hours, size peak residual shortfall, and report cash cost plus scenario lost contribution. Compare fee-only selection with the audited result and vary backup MW and lost contribution. Do not infer availability or realised savings from a global model median.

role_mandates.evidence_contract: Check dates, classifications and UTC trace alignment. Calculate delivery_audit. Published model statistics are context, not customer measurements or quotations.
role_mandates.project_finance_analyst: Recompute the input-bound audit before accepting a handoff. Include the fixed offer fee, backup capacity and energy cash costs, and separately show residual lost contribution. Preserve uncertainty and avoid authorizing procurement.
role_mandates.energy_orchestrator: Run evidence then finance using only ready registered tasks; reject external actions and expose failures.

input_schema: case.json v1.0: labelled synthetic USD finite-window case; ISO evidence dates no later than as_of; HTTPS published-model source; nonempty gaps/limitations; 1..87840 contiguous UTC hourly timestamps and aligned nonnegative MW deliveries for 2..20 uniquely named offers; positive total demand; nonnegative finite nonboolean fees, backup MW and costs. Bounds enforced by validate_case. Initial implementation rejects observed classifications.
evidence_requirements: Retain news and atlas URLs and event/publication/access dates.
Keep published model results, synthetic profiles, assumed prices and computed outputs separate.
Obtain customer traces, metering boundaries, engineering constraints, quotes and lost-margin evidence before deployment.
handoffs: Case to evidence schema and delivery audit
Input SHA256-bound delivery ledger to existing finance role
Human diligence on profiles, service terms and backup feasibility
output_contract: Source and input SHA256; coverage and full-hour counts before and after backup; peak deficit MW; residual MWh.
Fixed supply fee, backup capacity/energy cash costs, separate scenario lost contribution, economic cost and break-even lost contribution.
Fee-only comparator and direct deterministic/workflow parity; no agent superiority claim.
Purchase not authorized; evidence gaps explicit; LLM execution false and cost/latency/tokens unknown.
acceptance: Conserve demand = renewable + backup + residual; do not count surplus as served
Equal energy coverage can yield different full-hour coverage and backup MW
Reject modified/stale handoff and premature/external planner actions
Direct and scripted workflow numerical parity
Optional EDI checks source hash and delivered MWh; discovery alone never called execution
